title_en: Good News (10/20): A Village Gets Satellite Internet
note_en: 对…而言 means "for…" or "as far as… is concerned," and frames the rest of the sentence from someone's point of view: 对这个村子而言，能上网意味着孩子们第一次可以在网上听课 "for this village, being online means children can take classes online for the first time." It's a slightly more formal version of 对…来说, which appears later in the text: 对登山向导和背夫来说 "for mountain guides and porters."
